def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    spot_gbp_per_eur = 0.7343
    three_month_offer_points = 15.0
    points_scale = 10000
    contract_rate = 0.7400
    eur_notional = 5_000_000

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    current_three_month_offer = (
        spot_gbp_per_eur + three_month_offer_points / points_scale
    )
    mark_to_market_gain = (
        contract_rate - current_three_month_offer
    ) * eur_notional

    # return answer
    return round(mark_to_market_gain, 3)
